# Browser dependencies

- `@supabase/supabase-js` `2.112.4`
- SHA-256: `9a8142ffedb319a3ac0d4a8a123c9c2f7ffdb0e1e86cd9553889911b647175f6`

The admin site loads the exact local bundle and never receives a service-role
key.

OSV audit on 2026-08-30: no known vulnerabilities were returned for the exact
`2.112.4` versions of `supabase-js`, `auth-js`, `storage-js`, `realtime-js`,
`functions-js`, and `postgrest-js`.
